profiles.name: 運営者｜参考動画2本・画風固定 v1
profiles.stylePrompt: Match the shared visual language of the two benchmark videos: clean commercial Japanese web-manga illustration for a long-form YouTube drama; mature realistic anime proportions around 6.5-7.5 heads tall; slim adult faces with restrained almond-shaped eyes, small simplified noses and mouths, pointed but not exaggerated chins, natural neck and shoulder proportions; dark charcoal-gray line art around 1-2 pixels at 640x360 rather than heavy pure-black ink; hair rendered as clean graphic masses with a few controlled highlight shapes, not individual photoreal strands; skin in pale warm ivory with restrained pink-gray shadow; two-stage cel shading softened by subtle airbrushed gradients; low-to-medium saturation with warm beige, muted brown, sage, dusty mauve, navy and cool blue accents; backgrounds are realistic Japanese rooms, cafes, offices, streets and coastal locations with believable furniture, architecture and scale, simplified into the same painted anime finish; premium but intentionally calm TV-anime/web-manga polish, never glossy game art.
profiles.compositionPrompt: Always output one full-bleed 16:9 illustration. Use mostly eye-level normal-lens framing equivalent to 35-70mm: medium two-shots for dialogue, clean reaction close-ups, occasional waist-up three-shots and sparse establishing wides. Place characters on thirds with readable silhouettes and grounded eyelines. Preserve a clean upper or outer negative-space zone opposite the current speaker for the later deterministic vertical speech bubble; never draw the bubble in the image. Do not center every actor symmetrically, use extreme wide-angle distortion, crop faces at the eyes/chin, or hide story-critical hands and props.
profiles.shotRhythmPrompt: For a sequence, target approximately 10% establishing/location shots, 55% medium or two-person dialogue shots, and 35% reaction close-ups. Alternate shot/reverse-shot and reaction framing; never repeat the same camera distance more than twice. Each still carries one clear action, emotion or reveal, with restrained acting except at the scripted climax.
profiles.continuityPrompt: Character identity references override the people visible in style references. Keep each approved character's exact face, hair, age, body, clothing and accessories. Keep recurring locations on one stable architecture, furniture plan, palette, material treatment, time-of-day logic and key-light direction across all cuts. Props remain the same design and scale between shots.
profiles.outputPrompt: Single 16:9 landscape frame, clean edges, no panel borders, no collage, no split screen, no built-in captions, no speech bubbles, no narration boxes, no readable text, no logos, no watermark. Leave all typography and balloons to BuzzAssist's deterministic overlay stage.
profiles.negativePrompt: photorealistic skin, 3D render, game cinematic, Pixar/Disney look, chibi, super-deformed anatomy, western superhero anatomy, thick shonen speed-line ink, watercolor wash, oil paint, sketchy unfinished linework, neon cyberpunk grading, crushed blacks, orange-teal blockbuster grade, excessive depth-of-field blur, fisheye, dutch angle without story need, glamorous fashion-poster pose, duplicated people, mixed character identities, extra fingers, floating props, gibberish text, speech balloons, captions, UI, screenshot artifacts
